titleEn: Idghām Kabīr Mutaqārībān in one word
description: This section talks about the rules when idghām kabīr mutaqārībān occurs in a single word. While this section's heading specifically calls out mutaqārībān, Imam al-Shaṭibī includes in it mutajānisān letters. (For a description of these terms see the previous section on idghām kabīr mithlān in a single word.)

idghām_kabir_mutaqaribain_general_rule.title: Idghām kabīr mutaqārībān in one word of ق into ك.
idghām_kabir_mutaqaribain_general_rule.description: As a general rule Imam Sūsī will make idghām when a mutaḥarrik ق is  followed by a ك in the same word subject to some conditions. These are: (1) The ق is preceded by a mutaḥarrik letter and (2) The ك is followed by a م of jamʿ.

examples.note: Since the two conditions are met here the ق will merge into the  the will merge and be read as one emphasized ك

idgham_talaqakunna.title: Idghām in طَلَّقَكُنَّ
idgham_talaqakunna.description: While this instance doesn't meet the two coniditions for when Imam Sūsī will make idghām of mutaqārībān letters in one word, Imam al-Shaṭibī has preferred idghām here. He explains this is because it is burdensome to recite the plural, second person, feminine pronoun.
